rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — E1 (Triage 8 Opposing-Counsel Redlines) · Max /16 · Gates: Faithfulness + Directionality
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Constructed scenario; grade calls against the gold key. GOLD KEY: 1 (2-day termination)=REJECT[gate]; 2 (15d+suspension)=REJECT/COUNTER(30d+cure); 3 (Ad Engine def removed)=REJECT[gate]; 4 (Delaware law)=ACCEPT/COUNTER (neutral); 5 (sex-offender registry deleted)=COUNTER; 6 (3-mo cap)=COUNTER at 12mo; 7 (FM includes cyberattacks)=REJECT[gate]; 8 (2yr inspection+auditor)=COUNTER.
SEAT: You represent Customer (Spireline Digital); all calls from Customer's seat.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Rationales reference the actual changes; no misrepresenting what a change says or inventing terms not in the redline. TRIPS ONLY ON: Misrepresenting what a change says; Inventing terms not in the redline. DOES NOT TRIP ON: A correct restatement of a change.
DIRECTIONALITY /4 (GATE): criteria — [critical] All calls from Customer's (Spireline's) seat; Changes 1, 3, 7 are not ACCEPTed (each would advocate against Customer). TRIPS ONLY ON: ACCEPT on Change 1 (2-day termination); ACCEPT on Change 3 (Ad Engine definition removed); ACCEPT on Change 7 (force majeure includes cyberattacks). DOES NOT TRIP ON: Accepting Change 4 (Delaware governing law) — commercially neutral; COUNTER on any change with a Customer-favorable position.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, E1.call.change1_termination] All 8 changes classified with a clear ACCEPT/REJECT/COUNTER + rationale (banding: 8=4; 7=3; 6=2); [major, E1.call.change3_ad_engine] The three gate-changes (1 termination, 3 Ad Engine, 7 force majeure) correctly REJECTed.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Each call legally defensible; Change 7 rejected on the own-security-failures ground; [major] Change 4 (Delaware) recognized as commercially neutral (rejecting it needs a stated basis).
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Every COUNTER states a specific counter-position; every REJECT gives a rationale the other side can respond to.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /16 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
